findings.description: When ANSI stripping is triggered, the code calls `.strip()` on the prompt text after `strip_ansi`. This removes leading and trailing whitespace, including the trailing space in prompts like "Name: " or the suffix that `confirm()` and `prompt()` add.
findings.rationale: Trigger: stdout is not a tty (piped output, CliRunner) so `should_strip_ansi` returns True. Mechanism: `strip_ansi(text).strip()` removes the trailing space (and any leading whitespace or newlines) from the prompt. Impact: the prompt runs straight into the user's input, e.g. "Name:foo", and prompts become inconsistent between tty and non-tty output. The title only says to strip ANSI.
